title: Finish Lowpoly Play Surface
description: Fix lowpoly adhoc implementation: gumball shows without 3D by default, rock flashes on select then crashes with infinite loop in useLowpolyPlayHoverTarget. Fix getSnapshot caching and multiple Three.js instances.
summary:
Fixed lowpoly play surface crash and adhoc loading behavior.

Root causes:
1. useLowpolyPlayHoverTarget returned a new object from getSnapshot on every read, triggering React infinite update loop on hover/select.
2. LowpolyPlaySessionBridge effect depended on ctrl.getSelectedIds() (new array every render), causing constant WASM reload/scene flash.
3. Gumball rendered in object mode before session/sceneObjects were ready.
4. useLowpolySharedPlaySnapshot returned mutable object reference as snapshot, breaking useSyncExternalStore semantics.
5. LowpolyPlaySurfaceHost referenced runtime before useApp() initialization.

Fixes:
- Cached stable hoveredTargetSnapshot in LowpolyPlayController keyed by pointer-focus hover string.
- useLowpolyPlayHoverTarget subscribes via hoverRevision (number snapshot).
- useLowpolySharedPlaySnapshot subscribes via generation counter.
- Session bridge sync effect uses interactionRevision + fixtureJson string deps; runtime passed into SessionBridge.
- Gumball only active when session loaded, sceneObjects present, and selection/active object exists.

Verified with Playwright on http://127.0.0.1:6078: canvas loads, rock mesh + gumball render together, selection/hover produce no console errors.
